messages:
Maria G: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners and timelines for alert remediation items (noise, dedupe, thresholds, paging policy). I added a draft list in the PM doc.

Aj Patel: I'll take dedupe + pager routing rules. ETA 2 weeks. I'll file INF-2387 and add to the board.

Taylor R: I can do threshold tuning for the cache/redis alarms. Need 7d signal counts and 95th latency distribution first.

Samir K: I'll own recurring incident analysis (find repeat patterns across last 90d). Will run a weekly sweep and post results. Starting Mon.

Jess L: Proposal: reduce paging for warning-level from 03:00-07:00 for non-prod clusters and route to email only. :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:?

oncall-bot: Incident summary: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/IncidentSummary/INC-907 — auto-generated.

Maria G: Good. AJ, please include a short runbook snippet for the dedupe change (how to rollback) and PR template. Example config we discussed:

```
alert_rule:
  name: high-error-rate
  expr: sum(rate(api_errors[5m])) by (service) > 50
  severity: page
  dedupe_window: 10m
  group_by: [service]
  route: primary -> dedupe -> oncall
```

Aj Patel: Will do. I'll also add a canary flag so we can test on one service first.

Taylor R: For thresholds I can start with these anchors: 95th latency 300ms for prod, 600ms for staging. Will validate against historical.

Samir K: I'll publish a quarterly recurring doc with top 10 noisy alerts and sources. Goal: reduce >50% of pages from the list in 90 days.

Maria G: Action items summary (please confirm):
- Aj: dedupe + routing PR + INF-2387 + rollback steps — due 2025-06-05
- Taylor: threshold tuning + data report — due 2025-05-20
- Samir: weekly incident sweep + recurring report — first report 2025-05-12
- Jess: finalize paging windows policy, coordinate w/ SRE ops — due 2025-05-16

Aj Patel: Confirmed. I'll post the PR link when ready.

Jess L: I'll run a quick sim in next 48h and post results.

Maria G: Let's have a 15m sync next Tue 10:30 to unblock owners. If anything slips, post updates to the INF-2387 ticket and ping here. Thanks everyone :rocket:
